calls.description: Low soft throaty waking grunt like a large drowsy pigeon, short chesty puff with beak barely open.
Sharp startled throaty squawk-coo like a frightened large pigeon, brief rising chesty burst.
Soft questioning throaty coo like a curious large Nicobar pigeon, two low rolling notes tilting upward.
Long sad low throaty coo like a mourning large pigeon, slow trembling breathy note held against paint.
A soft, low, sleepy two-note coo from a large drowsy pigeon settling down to sleep, fading out; clearly a bird's voice, not a breath or a human sigh.
calls.previous_description: Sleepy sighing throaty exhale like a drowsy large pigeon settling, soft low deflating breath.
calls.revised_by: Muse Wonder critique of v3: the sigh read as human (2026-11-02)

shots.sound: Soft evening breeze moves through ebony leaves with faint distant forest birds settling low under the canopy.
Fading birdsong thins into still blue-dusk air with gentle leaf rustle settling toward quiet.
Early morning traffic rumbles with bus brakes hissing and hurried footsteps washing over the pavement garden.
A loud bus horn blasts past with rushing air and blurred pedestrian footsteps pounding close behind.
Quick light shuffling on stone echoes in the alley with distant motorbike putters and faint market chatter.
Murmuring street crowd hums beneath the gateway with soft wind in leaves and faint distant drumming.
Canal water laps softly against stone with drifting gull cries and palm fronds rustling in light breeze.
Low market hum buzzes around the shop wall with a hanging lamp creaking faintly and leaves trembling outside.
High hilltop wind whistles through grasses with the city rumbling very far below in soft haze.
Excited crowd murmurs rise in the plaza with rapid phone camera clicks and soft shoe shuffles on stone.
Tight crowd shuffling closes in with rising anxious murmurs and many overlapping phone shutters clicking.
Broad crowd swell holds in a tense hushed circle with faint whispers shifting under hanging umbrellas.
Wooden slats knock and scrape as the heavy lid swings shut with muffled crowd movement outside.
Truck engine drones low with metal harbour clanks and deep ship horns rolling across water through slats.
Iron gates squeak open with gravel crunching under wheels and soft approaching footsteps in muted open air.
Muffled visitor murmurs blend with awe-filled gasps and endless phone shutters clicking against glass.
Rapid camera shutters burst in quick succession with harsh electronic pops amid restless murmurs.
Hushed indoor room tone breathes softly with distant muffled crowd and faint air hum.
Soft feet shuffle slowly in dry sand with faint rustle echoing lightly off the painted wall.
Deep near-silence holds with only a faint dusty scrape as feathers brush the peeling painted wall.
Vast empty enclosure echoes faintly with low lingering air hum and soft distant reverberation.
Warm still air hangs quietly with faint dust drifting and a very soft room settle fading toward silence.
Complete silence holds with no place or action sound remaining.
